scenario: Negation under logical per LLOG.4.2 — a logical fact is justified by the absence of a matching fact. Quiet is emitted when no Noise exists. Once Noise is asserted the not-pattern fails and Quiet retracts.
rules_ds:
schema Noise scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Quiet scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule r:
    no Noise
->
    emit Quiet logical dummy: 0
